Its conception-and-realization citation is more sharply delimited than a general precision award, though original roles and systematic records still require review. BAO and the neutrino population are profound but their proposed prediction/survey or detector/analysis allocations are less settled here. I judge these distinctions, not supporters; mature discoveries leave no award last.
